settings.text: Wellness Designed for the Way You Want to Live

Kiva Wellness creates considered wellness products that help you sleep better, recover better and feel better in everyday life.

Since 2016, we’ve been bringing proven wellness practices and modern technology into Australian homes through a growing range of infrared saunas, traditional saunas, ice baths, red light therapy and sleep solutions.

But Kiva has never simply been about the products. It’s about creating the space, tools and rituals that make taking care of yourself easier to do - and easier to keep doing.

settings.heading: Our Story
settings.text:
Kiva Wellness began in 2016 from a humble garage in northern New South Wales. The idea was simple: some of the most valuable wellness practices - heat, cold, light, sleep and recovery - shouldn’t be reserved for elite athletes, luxury retreats or occasional visits to wellness studios. They should be accessible at home.

What started small has grown into an established Australian wellness brand serving customers across Australia and New Zealand. Along the way, our range has expanded from recovery products into a broader ecosystem of home wellness solutions, including infrared and traditional saunas, ice baths and chillers, red light therapy, and technology designed to support better sleep.

Today, our products can be found in homes, gyms, recovery spaces and wellness businesses throughout Australia and New Zealand, including organisations such as Snap Fitness, P3 Recovery and World Gym.

And while Kiva has grown, the reason we exist remains much the same: to help make feeling better part of everyday life.

settings.heading: Why Kiva Exists
settings.text:
Modern life asks a lot from us. We spend more time switched on, connected and stimulated, while many of the things that help us feel our best - quality sleep, recovery, movement, stillness and time to reset - are pushed further down the list.

Kiva was created to help change that. We believe wellness doesn’t need to mean completely changing your life. Often, it begins with creating better rituals within the life you already have.

A sauna at the end of the day. A cold immersion after training. Red light therapy as part of your morning routine. A better environment for sleep.

Small practices, repeated consistently, can become something much more powerful. That is the thinking behind every Kiva product: to make meaningful wellness easier to access, understand and incorporate into daily life.

settings.heading: Where Science Meets Ritual
settings.text:
We’re interested in wellness practices that have substance behind them. Some, like sauna and cold-water immersion, have been practised for generations. Others, including red light therapy and modern sleep technology, continue to develop alongside emerging research and innovation.

Our role is to bring these worlds together. We combine proven wellness practices, thoughtful product design and evolving technology to create products that are both effective and enjoyable to use. Because the best wellness product isn’t simply the one with the longest feature list - it’s the one you want to use again tomorrow.

Wellness at Home

We believe some of the most valuable moments for your wellbeing can happen without leaving home. That philosophy has shaped the Kiva range.

The wellness industry has changed enormously since Kiva began. Trends come and go. New technologies appear. New brands emerge. We think longevity matters. It gives us the opportunity to learn from thousands of customer interactions, continuously improve our products and stand behind the people who choose Kiva. For larger wellness purchases in particular, the product is only part of the decision. A warranty is only as strong as the company behind it. That’s why we believe trust, service and long-term support matter just as much as specifications on a product page.

settings.heading: Our Philosophy
settings.text:
We don’t believe wellness is about becoming a completely different person. It’s about giving yourself more opportunities to feel energised, rested, capable and present. To recover when your body needs recovery. To slow down when life is moving quickly. To create a little space between one day and the next. And to build habits that support the person you’re becoming.

That might begin with ten minutes of red light. A sauna before bed. A cold plunge after training. Or simply a better night’s sleep.

There is no perfect wellness routine. There is only the one that works for you - and that you can keep coming back to.

Kiva Wellness is an Australian wellness company specialising in home saunas, ice baths and cold therapy, red light therapy, sleep technology and recovery products. Founded in northern New South Wales in 2016, Kiva serves customers throughout Australia and New Zealand, from individual households to gyms, recovery centres and wellness businesses. Our goal is simple:
To make better recovery, better rest and better everyday wellbeing easier to bring home
Wellness doesn't have to happen somewhere else. Create the space to pause, recover and recharge - at home, on your terms. Sleep Better. Recover Better. Live Better.
